arguments.value: This agreement is between the Town of Vinton, Virginia and Roanoke Gas Company, Virginia corporations/municipal corporation as stated in the source. The Town of Vinton renews Roanoke Gas Company’s gas franchise for 20 years starting January 1, 2016, allowing the company to construct, operate, maintain, repair, reconstruct, and extend a gas distribution system within Vinton. In exchange, Roanoke Gas Company must pay Vinton a pro rata share of a franchise fee based on gas sales in Vinton, Roanoke, and Salem, with the total fee for all three localities set at $98,196 for 2016 and increasing 3% annually thereafter. Roanoke Gas Company must keep at least one business office in Vinton open at least 40 hours per week and may not discriminate unlawfully in employment. Notices must be sent to the listed addresses. The source does not state a governing law.
